$comment: The home-screen widget's colours and made-up preview figures, for both platforms, in one place (audit 2026-11-08 §6.3). scripts/widget-assets.mjs writes the Android resources and the generated regions of the Swift files from this; `--check` (CI) fails when any of them was edited by hand. Each role lists the platform names that use it; `app` names the ThemeContext token a role must equal (__tests__/contract/widgetAssets.test.ts). Android 12+ draws from the wallpaper (`dynamic`, Material 3 tonal palettes); everything else is fixed.

preview.$comment: The widget picker's made-up month: never user data. JS formats these in the user's currency (features/widgets/snapshot.ts); the static fallbacks below (Android 12-14 previewLayout, the iOS gallery before the app has run) use en-US grouping.

primary.$comment: Darker than the app's accentGreen in light mode, so white text on it reaches 4.5:1 at widget sizes.

warning.$comment: Over budget: 4.5:1 or better on the surface for small text. Fixed on Android 12+ too (no tonal palette is a warning).

accent.$comment: iOS: the system tints or glasses widgets itself on iOS 26+ Home Screens (accented rendering); these apply in full colour.
